scope: Instrumented native source runtime, not portable-release FPS acceptance or physical presentation/input latency. Cold rows mean this game process cache, not full process launch latency or a flushed OS cache; optional foreground waiting and source hashing precede game instantiation and are retained separately from measured cases. Warm and travel rows stay separate. No source/package/promotion edits; engine preferences live only in the isolated profile. The shared checked-engine runner validates process results, but does not expose a numeric exit code when Windows leaves it unavailable.
exit_code_scope: Not exposed by the shared checked-engine runner; clean launcher return, exact completion marker, complete receipt and empty stderr are required.

window_assessment.scope: Only contiguous unavailable-handle startup/shutdown boundaries are excluded, explicitly counted and retained. Every available sample must prove exact owned HWND client pixels, foreground, visibility and non-minimization. Approximately 500ms samples do not prove continuous focus, unobscured presentation, displayed frames, GPU time or input latency. Process memory is sampled working set/private committed bytes, not GPU memory or proof of a leak.

frame_present_tool_availability.scope: Read-only PATH and named-directory availability check only; no executable, service or capture is started. WPR availability alone is not a configured frame-present trace. No machine-wide installation inventory is claimed.

foreground_arming_assessment.scope: Original Windows observations remain unchanged and retained. Only an explicitly requested, bounded pre-instantiation arm can label earlier observations SETUP. Every later available observation still requires exact owned pixels and foreground; missing interior observations and focus loss fail. Setup assessment is diagnostic, not admitted gameplay. Samples and engine focus events do not prove uninterrupted OS focus or physical frame presentation.

runtime_identity_before.authority: Generated from canonical production runtime source records; delivery, publication and acceptance remain separate.

runtime_identity_after.authority: Generated from canonical production runtime source records; delivery, publication and acceptance remain separate.

benchmark.activity_scope: Process intervals are partitioned by the preceding frame's post-process world state: loading, cast_or_projectile, paid_ground, post_effect_idle, idle. Full mode only; paid_ground means world presence, not visibility. Region samples separately identify visible paid ground and preserve process-frame IDs. Categories do not claim physical presentation timing.
benchmark.adapter: ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics (0x00001506) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11-32.0.21045.5002)
benchmark.all_fixed_steps_scope: Explicit full-observer option only. Exactly one bounded before/after completed-stage group per admitted process, including zero-step frames; no per-tick history. Fixed nine cumulative elapsed/count lanes commit only successful steps. Failed steps, world/epoch changes, missing groups or inconsistent clocks invalidate attribution. Totals include every catch-up step and preserve the older final-step fields separately. Stage intervals are nested in Bootstrap process time and include observer overhead; residual work remains unassigned, not rendering or GPU time. Default and light perform no cumulative snapshots or accumulation. Snapshot copying is outside the process timer; enabled counter updates are inside it.
benchmark.court_preparation_scope: Full mode per-draw geometry and bundle timers plus elapsed drawing_and_other remainder. The remainder includes command submission and observer overhead, not GPU execution; nested surface and region timers are not additive.
benchmark.draw_stage_scope: Full mode clears stage storage immediately before each actual Bootstrap._draw call. main_draw_stages_us and main_draw_contexts align by index with draw_submission_elapsed_ms. Each context records a monotonic callback serial, process frame and entry phase. Loading/no-world callbacks have current empty stages, counted as zero for any stage observed elsewhere in that case; full draw elapsed time remains measured. No categories are invented if the entire case has no gameplay stages. Earlier receipts could repeat stale gameplay stage dictionaries during loading; their cold stage statistics are not valid.
benchmark.fixtures: Fresh120Hz world per independent case, ordinary paid SimCommand casts, no measured-period refill. Direct placement/equip happens before warm measurement. Cold travel uses actual authored menu travel. Focus loss is observed, while deterministic commands continue.
benchmark.focus_scope: Engine focus is sampled once per recorded process callback and at case endpoints; wrapper separately validates exact owned HWND/client dimensions and sampled foreground. Synthetic commands continue through lost focus so failed evidence remains inspectable. Neither sampling path proves continuous focus or physical presentation.

foreground_arming.scope: SETUP: native Start button before source snapshot and TimedGame instantiation. An actual button pressed event must precede1000ms of sampled focus with no poll gap above250ms. Focus polled each process callback; at most3001 records at least100ms apart during the five-minute setup window. No input synthesis is performed. Godot focus alone is not OS foreground proof; independent Windows admission remains mandatory. All post-arm process callbacks and focus-exit events are counted, including preparation/warmups. Raw Windows rows retain their UTC setup/measurement boundary.

manifest.authority: Generated from canonical production runtime source records; delivery, publication and acceptance remain separate.

benchmark.manifest_note: Generated runtime identity is recorded here; exact source-to-manifest binding is checked by the separate packaging gate.
benchmark.observation_storage_scope: At most12000 aligned callback record groups per stream per case and120000 groups across this run, in either observer mode. Each group has a fixed set of scalar/context fields or bounded runtime stage/material keys. Overflow stops collection, retains the partial case and fails the run; it never silently samples or admits truncated quantiles. Split long/high-frame-rate matrices into fresh runs. Raw result copies/JSON add transient memory beyond these record counts.
benchmark.observed_source_scope: Independent raw-byte filesystem hashes of project.godot, this benchmark, src/*.gd, scenes/*.tscn and *.tres, content/*.json except the generated identity, and assets/shaders/*.gdshader (recursive). Sorted path<TAB>SHA256<LF> records are SHA256 hashed. Start/end snapshots detect source drift; they do not hash imported textures, certify a pack, or prove code was not edited and restored between snapshots. Source reading occurs outside measured intervals and may warm OS file cache.
benchmark.observer_overhead_scope: Benchmark _process head and tail, excluding elapsed Bootstrap._process: interval recording, synthetic focus bookkeeping, focus/counters, final-step copies, paid-cell membership and memory monitors when enabled. Excludes draw/render-setup observation and the overhead of timers embedded inside Bootstrap/SimWorld. Includes scheduling waits, not pure CPU cost.
benchmark.observer_policy: Light mode retains frame/process/draw intervals, tick/endpoints and inexpensive counters; disables per-frame occupied-membership queries, memory monitors, stage dictionaries and nested component timers. Unavailable metrics are null, never inferred maxima. Both modes remain instrumented, not physical-presentation measurements.
benchmark.process_timer_scope: Elapsed Bootstrap._process call only; excludes benchmark head/tail observation. Earlier receipts included head bookkeeping. Embedded simulation and nested component timer overhead remains inside this value in full mode.

results.label: startup_arrival
results.loading_counter_scope: Post-process observations. Terrain retains its original meaning; area is terrain or explicit Garden arrival. Garden and terrain counts can overlap and must not be added. A final preparation frame that becomes ready within its process is not counted as still loading.

terrain_after.memory_scope: Logical retained validation payloads and conservative Image/copy/reconstruction overlap only; excludes hash context, dictionaries, pool resources, allocator/COW behavior, resident textures and driver memory. Not RSS.

profile.scope: Worker SHA-256 validation. Eight fixed main-thread elapsed interval keys, not thread CPU counters; scheduling and driver waits may be included. byte_snapshot measures obtaining detached Image bytes, not hashing or a guaranteed physical copy. Worker hash elapsed is separately observed and may overlap main work or include descheduling; never add it to a frame total or subtract it as a speedup. Texture creation measures submission, not GPU execution. Normal collection polls then joins completed tasks only; final teardown may wait. Source Image and exact-byte reconstruction remain main-thread. Worker intervals dispatched before the most recent profile reset are excluded from that capture; current-window collection work is still recorded. No sample history.

benchmark.retained_campus_scope: Six fixed child CanvasItems. Endpoint counter deltas include layer redraw requests, actual draw callbacks and inclusive draw-command generation time in full mode. Child draws run outside Bootstrap._draw; main draw elapsed alone cannot measure the change. Preparation elapsed is nested inside Bootstrap._process. These values are not GPU/present time or a total frame-cost sum. Light mode retains counts but disables all child timing; immediate reference keeps its main-campus timer.
benchmark.scope: Instrumented native source runtime. Main-thread elapsed timers can include scheduling/driver waits. Frame-start intervals are not GPU time, physical presentation or input-to-photon latency. Nested timers are not additive. No 60FPS acceptance is inferred. Optional manual foreground setup occurs before game instantiation; source loading, empty-window setup, waiting and provenance hashing are excluded from game startup/case timers. Cold rows mean this game's process cache, not full process launch latency or a flushed OS cache.
benchmark.statistics: Nearest-rank quantiles of raw process-start intervals; short samples do not establish stable tails. Sequential profile order is recorded; repeat in reverse order for comparisons.
benchmark.viewport_render_timing_scope: Optional, full observer only. At most root and two existing POV viewports; one fixed three-row group per admitted render_setup callback. Pre-draw effective RenderingServer policy is expected update eligibility, not proof of rendering (especially WHEN_VISIBLE); the requested node policy is recorded separately because it retains consumed ONCE requests. Effective-policy getters may synchronize the render thread, adding observer cost. CPU/GPU values are Godot's last stored engine readings, not necessarily the observation frame: the API exposes no source-frame ID. First eligible reading per case, after target replacement or any inactive gap is flagged warmup_or_resumed; inactive/absent targets are not queried and remain null. Numeric zero is retained without claiming true zero work or supported GPU timestamps. Per-role summaries separate continuous and warmup readings, never sum viewports or CPU/GPU. Timing instrumentation and callback bookkeeping add uncalibrated cost; callback totals exclude engine timestamp overhead. No player VSync/frame-cap change or physical-present inference.
